text: Resolving Persistent App Login / OTP Failures Document ID: SOP_C13_APP_ACCESS_ISSUES Category: C13 — App & Self-Care Portal Department: Digital Channels Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To provide a consistent troubleshooting and escalation path for customers unable to log in to the My NovaTel app. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Confirm SIM has active signal and the device is not on Airplane Mode. Attempt OTP resend after the mandatory 30-second cooldown. If OTP still fails, offer 'Login via Missed Call' as an alternate verification method. If account shows 'Locked' status, advise the 30-minute auto-unlock window or process a manual unlock after identity verification. Escalate to Digital Channels engineering if failures are reported at scale (>50 tickets/hour) as a potential platform incident. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and
title: Resolving Persistent App Login / OTP Failures
